north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.
shared_style_prompt: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in the established Aachu/Zuv hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink carousel look. Identity reference images are the highest-priority face source: preserve the same recurring real-person faces, warm medium-brown South Asian skin tones, Aachu's expressive dark eyes and long dark wavy hair, and Zuv's curly dark hair, strong brows, dark almond eyes, defined nose, short natural stubble, and gentle smile. Previous successful carousel illustrations are style references only: use them for warm ivory paper texture, soft watercolor washes, fine ink and pencil linework, delicate sketch lines, gentle crosshatching, muted vintage palette, composition, wardrobe continuity, handwritten typography, and recurring props. Do not use style references as identity references. Keep the illustration premium, intimate, travel-light, emotionally soft, and story-first, with tactile clothing/prop detail, clean expressive faces, warm negative space, and one clear Aachu/Zuv behavior scene. The scene must be storyboard-first and stage-scene driven: action, reaction, eye-line, hands, body distance, object movement, silence, consequence, reversal, and payoff must be visible before text is considered. Text completes the scene; text must not carry the scene. Paper artifacts, receipts, labels, posters, or stationery can appear only as tiny integrated scene details, never as the main visual system. Render the exact slide copy as fixed handwritten-style dark charcoal text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
compact_style_prompt: premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink illustration on warm ivory paper, fine ink/pencil linework, soft watercolor wash, muted vintage palette, recurring Aachu/Zuv faces, model-native handwritten text, tiny @a.storyof.two brandmark
shared_negative_prompt: No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no glossy AI look, no flat vector art, no corporate/startup illustration, no stock Indian couple style, no generic model faces, no anime, no doll-like faces, no children's cartoon style, no Canva quote-card design, no complex background, no overcrowded props, no dramatic shadows, no harsh contrast, no neon colors, no gradients, no isometric style, no Pixar/Disney style, no hyper-detailed faces, no perfect vector geometry, no heavy black outlines, no large logo, no random unreadable text, no extra decorative clutter, no mean-spirited humor, no generic self-help poster energy.

model_native_master_prompt.rule: Every final image-generation prompt must use the project master prompt structure before slide-specific scene details. The master prompt defines asset type, reference image roles, primary request, character identity lock, face preservation, watercolor-and-ink style, color palette, composition, emotional direction, wardrobe continuity, recurring props, background style, line/texture details, anatomy/quality rules, text rule, and final rendering layer.
model_native_master_prompt.reference_image_roles: Identity references control face, hair, skin tone, age, ethnicity, body language, and emotional presence. Previous successful illustrations control only style, palette, line quality, composition, wardrobe continuity, and recurring props.
model_native_master_prompt.text_rule: Exact slide copy and @a.storyof.two brandmark must be generated inside the image in fixed handwritten storybook typography. Local overlays are legacy fallback only.

typography.placement: generous whitespace; copy should be scene-native and complete the staged action, not drive the slide as poster copy

public_copy_policy.name_rule: Do not force Aachu/Zuv, Anchal/Himanshu, or other private names into every public slide or caption. Use names only when the story naturally needs them.
public_copy_policy.internal_identity_rule: Keep Aachu/Zuv as internal character anchors for likeness, role, prompt consistency, and visual review.
public_copy_policy.review_rule: Golden-theme alignment can be proven through behavior, care, posture, expression, and objects; it does not require visible name repetition.

visual_cues: ivory sherwani with subtle pastel embroidery when wedding-relevant

identity_reference_policy.rule: Treat identity_images/ as a candidate library, not as one prompt dump. Every carousel should use a small curated identity bundle chosen for that story.
hard_fail_if: A run feeds the entire identity_images/ folder into the image model.
A run depends on one default Aachu/Zuv identity image for every future carousel.
Identity references appear only in metadata and not in every slide prompt's Identity continuity lock.
Final image generation uses text-only identity descriptions instead of passing the selected identity files as actual image inputs.
A generated slide is accepted as final even though Aachu/Zuv face structure is generic or not recognizably based on the selected identity bundle.
Image generation starts before identity-consistency-review.json passes.
Outfit variety becomes the premise instead of evidence for the relationship truth.

concept_selection_policy.rule: Do not finalize a carousel idea from a single recommendation. Generate 5-10 distinct concept variants, score each on the 30-point Golden Theme rubric, and let a selector choose the highest-rated option.
hard_fail_if: A final carousel idea is recommended without a scored variant table.
The selected concept scores below 28/30 and is not repaired before packaging.
Image generation starts before the selector verdict exists.

stage_scene_policy.rule: After Layer E and before hooks, slide copy, prompt finalization, or image generation, every serious carousel route must be staged as visible action. The viewer should understand the relationship beat if poster text is hidden.
stage_scene_policy.copy_rule: Text completes the scene; text must not carry the scene.
hard_fail_if: A recommended idea is only a text spine or candidate table.
The visual plan is a quote-card, poster-copy layout, or generic couple pose.
Aachu and Zuv are merely standing beside the line instead of acting inside the beat.
The story cannot be understood when the on-image text is hidden.
Layer E is not visible in the creator-facing decision record.
The continuous C-layer council is skipped before recommendation.

visual_debate_policy.rule: After copy is confirmed and post-copy-visual-room.json returns GO, and before visual plan finalization, carousel packaging, or image generation, run three visual agents that ideate, critique, and select the strongest visual system.
visual_debate_policy.depends_on: post-copy-visual-room.json when creator has confirmed copy
hard_fail_if: Image generation starts before visual-debate.json exists.
Creator-confirmed copy exists but post-copy-visual-room.json is missing or not GO.
The visual plan repeats one prop, color accent, object, or location across every slide without a story reason.
The visual plan defaults to home interiors after the creator asks for outside/public visuals.
The visual plan makes objects, outfits, or places the premise instead of relationship evidence.
Zuv's care is passive, absent, performative, or framed as rescue.

post_copy_visual_room_policy.rule: When the creator confirms copy, lock the approved words and run a mandatory visual creative room before final visual debate, prompt-pack finalization, or image generation.
run_after: copy.json or chat-approved copy is locked
hard_fail_if: The flow moves from approved copy directly to prompts or image generation.
Fewer than three visual systems are compared.
The selected visuals decorate the copy but do not prove it through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior.
A reference format is copied as frames, likenesses, or exact labels instead of abstracted into original mechanics.
Text placement is not planned separately for native 4:5 and native 9:16 outputs.
decision_record_required_fields: three or more visual system candidates

viral_reference_pattern.performance_note: Reference @a.storyof.two sidecar: high follower/like/share response and copied by others.
viral_reference_pattern.core_mechanic: Reuse the storytelling architecture, not the literal hook. Start with a universal relationship truth, reveal the specific Aachu/Zuv angle, prove it one beat at a time with concrete visual details, turn the joke or observation into tenderness, then land on a save/share-worthy thesis.
do_not_reuse_as_global_template: Do not make every carousel start with 'He didn't marry...'.
Do not repeat 'He married...' as the default slide grammar.
Do not copy the old winning sentence pattern unless the new story specifically earns that wording.
story_architecture: Universal hook: one instantly readable relationship truth, tension, or curiosity gap.
Special revelation: the specific Aachu/Zuv interpretation that makes this not generic couple content.
Proof beat 1: a concrete visual detail from the real photo, object, habit, or moment.
Proof beat 2: a second, sharper or more memeable detail that escalates the idea.
Pattern recognition: show the relationship rhythm behind the isolated details.
Emotional turn: reveal what the funny, pretty, or chaotic details actually mean emotionally.
Save/share thesis: one line friends can send to partners because it feels true.
voice_rules: Use short handwritten lines, usually one sentence per slide.
Keep the humor affectionate, never mocking.
Use Hinglish sparingly as the emotional truth line, not as decoration.
Prefer concrete couple behaviors over abstract romance.
Preserve the theme grammar, not the sentence grammar of any prior carousel.
End with a shareable thesis that friends can send to partners.
visual_rules: One clear illustrated beat per slide on warm off-white background.
Aachu carries expressive chaos through posture, face, dupatta, shoes, food, suitcase, tears, or sudden mood shifts.
Zuv stays visually steady: smiling, holding shoes, tissue, water, snacks, charger, or simply sitting closer.
Use recurring wedding/desi details when relevant: lehenga, sherwani, jasmine, mehendi, marigold, diya.
Final slide should soften the figures and foreground a simple metaphor object.
Every final slide must have two native generated outputs: 4:5 Instagram post and 9:16 Reels/Stories.
Do not derive the Reels/Stories output by resizing, cropping, padding, or extending the Instagram post output.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

production_gate.rule: Identity photos are references for likeness, clothing, posture, and relationship energy. Style references are references for model-native composition, handwritten copy, brandmark, clothing fidelity, and warm paper illustration. Default final art must be generated as complete publishable slides with copy and brandmark inside the image; local overlays are legacy fallback only.
production_gate.approved_creation_path: Use scripts/create_illustration_carousel.py and the C-layer artifact contract for new carousel work. One-off carousel renderers are not allowed unless they are explicitly approved as legacy fixtures.
